decisions.reason: The title omitted regularity from the codimension-one assertion, although the Statement and step 3.1 explicitly require it. Reduced diagonal closure and proper gluing give an integral projective modification; over each height-one regular local DVR, every affine chart meeting the closed fibre equals that DVR, and finite presentation spreads the isomorphism. Dominance gives torsion-free coordinate rings and flatness. Corrected only the title; the Statement and proof remain unchanged.

Confirmed a fatal proof gap: the final Statement covers every finite fraction-field extension of a complete trait, but old step 4.1 and F1 establish normalization finiteness only for separable extensions. Preserved the Statement and supplied steps 1.2 and 5.1. The separable normalization is finite and complete, with lifted Artinian idempotents forcing locality. Over that complete DVR the purely inseparable part has the explicit valuation w(x)=v_s(x^q)/q. Norm equivalence bounds its integral closure inside a finite lattice, proving finiteness; the discrete value group makes it a DVR, and finite-module completion gives completeness. Its residue field is finite, hence unchanged over an algebraically closed residue field.
